description: Slideous splits slides on heading level==1 only (unlike revealjs/slidy/s5/dzslides, which split on level<=2) — verified against this writer's source, not assumed from pandoc's convention. Two H1 headings produce two content slides (plus an auto-generated title slide from doc metadata), covering paragraph, bold/italic emphasis, bullet list, code block, and an image (, which this writer does render unlike revealjs/slidy/s5/dzslides)
